## About
Tisdel's Garage is a locally owned and operated, family owned shop on Penn Ave South in Minneapolis, right next to Broders. We perform all vehicle repairs from front to back, top to bottom, and we have a long history of quality repairs.
You'll deal with people you know by name: Tony is our president, Kim is our secretary, A.J. is our lead tech and Ian is our technician. One reviewer said Kim gave her immediate comfort, and another said the place reminded him of his grandfather's garage.
Tired of the dealer's high prices and hard selling? Bring your car to a neighborhood shop with a full in house machine shop for the jobs that need something special.

## Services
- Used car purchase inspections: Get any used car checked before you put money down or sign documents.
- Problems the dealer couldn't find: We track down the problems the dealer or other shops couldn't find or didn't want to spend the time on.
- Mechanical repairs: All mechanical repairs, front to back, top to bottom.
- Light body work: Light body work done in house.
- Wheels and tires: Wheels and tires along with your other repairs.
- Welding and machining: Full in house welding and machining.
- Special fabrication and repair projects: A full machine shop with an in house CNC mill and manual tool room lathe.

## FAQ
Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. We have night time drop off with a key drop in the large garage door. Keys must be dropped off with the vehicle.

Q: What if I get your voicemail?
A: Call back in 5-10 minutes or leave a message, and we will call back as soon as we can.

Q: Where exactly are you?
A: We're on Penn Ave South, right next to Broders.

Q: How quickly do you answer email?
A: We check email as often as we can, but in the summer it may not be until late evening or early the next morning because of heavy work loads.
